name: Fireworks AI
tagline: Fast inference and fine-tuning for production AI
description: Fireworks AI is a generative-AI inference platform optimised for low-latency serving of open and proprietary models. Customers fine-tune, host, and serve models with usage-based pricing. October 2025 funding put valuation at $4B with growing enterprise traction for production GenAI workloads.
pricingDetails: Serverless tokens: $0.10/M (<4B params), $0.20/M (4-16B), $0.90/M (16B+). GPU on-demand: $2.90-$9/hr. $1 free credit.
